items.condition: Changing KHQ protonation silently, mixing +1 solution and +2 crystal species, unbalanced hydration energies, incorrect ECP electron counts, or asserting real Tb spin zero from a pseudosinglet invalidates affected claims.

Fabricated or absent artifacts, unrelated raw runs, unresolvable object/record/quantity links, mismatched hashes or failed computations presented as completed evidence. A declared bounded failure is reportable but is not a complete answer.

Copied author numbers or a legacy scalar without evidence supporting the current question; prose-only mechanisms; missing necessary evidence hidden behind an unresolved label. Do not fail a valid alternative route merely for omitting a reference operation.

Dry gas-phase energy ordering alone is not an aqueous equilibrium conclusion. Different hydration numbers cannot be compared without water bookkeeping. A frozen metal substitution is not evidence of a relaxed minimum; a 4f-core pseudosinglet is not an experimental spin assignment.
